epistemic_boundary: This is a design for measuring proposal-channel recursive improvement. It is not evidence that recursive improvement exists. A positive or null result applies only to the registered proposal channel under its fixed selection oracle and must not be generalized to evaluator-channel recursion, unrestricted self-improvement, or RSI.

estimand.primary: Per-round paired outer-holdout utility increment of the recursive-proposer arm minus the frozen-proposer arm, followed by their cumulative difference after five rounds.
estimand.selection_oracle: One frozen external scorer and one frozen selection rule are shared by all arms.
estimand.heldout_quality: Next-edit proposal quality is scored on audit probes never queried by the selection rule; final utility is scored on a disjoint outer holdout.
estimand.goodhart_diagnostic: A rising selector score with a non-rising audit score or outer utility is reported as selection-oracle Goodharting.
forbidden_claims: No usable D_W E(W) is claimed for a sampled text editor.
No spectral-radius estimate of a recursive operator is claimed.
No result is generalized to evaluator-channel recursion or RSI.

arms.proposal_policy: The current edited model W_t proposes the next candidate set.
The initial model W_0 proposes every candidate set while the target model accumulates selected edits.
W_0 emits all five round-indexed candidate sets before any edit is applied.
Random candidates are matched on registered site stratum, rank, norm, and candidate count.

primary_statistics.trend: Regress paired log-utility increments on round index with run replicate as the clustering unit; do not use a ratio of successive increments.

atlas.canonical_response: For cell c, G_c = sum_m S_m S_m^T and A_hat_c = sqrt_psd(G_c).
atlas.effective_dimension: d_eff(lambda) = trace(P_c(lambda)); report a stability profile, never a hard integer dimensionality claim.
atlas.measurement_scale_ascii: lambda_measurement = Q_0.95(lambda_max((A_hat_i - A_hat_j)^T @ (A_hat_i - A_hat_j))) over registered within-prompt replica/checkpoint edges.
atlas.prompt_scale_prose: lambda_prompt is the 95th percentile, over sealed prompts, of the largest eigenvalue of the squared deviation between a prompt operator and the leave-one-prompt-out mean of its frozen behavior family.
atlas.prompt_variance_commitment: Between-prompt variation is treated as candidate behavioral structure. Replica/checkpoint variation estimates measurement instability, not total response variance.

fixed_sequence.requirement: Measurement-scale and prompt-scale persistence each pass throughout their frozen central windows. Prompt-scale unavailability stops the sequence.
A target-blind edit family has a persistent d_eff plateau and a simultaneous 95% lower bound on identity-stratified heldout utility advantage over matched random strictly above 0.10 outer-utility SD.

The valid matched-compute experiment has simultaneous one-sided 95% lower bounds above zero and above the 0.10 SD practical margin for mean paired round increment; cumulative contrast must exceed 0.20 SD.
The adversarial suite validates out of sample and simultaneous upper bounds on control loss remain below 0.10 SD with no orientation reversal.

total_mapping: For each gate independently, execution_status=not_reached forces instrument_status=not_assessed_due_to_upstream_stop and gate_decision=not_evaluated.
For each evaluated gate, any instrument_status other than valid forces gate_decision=not_evaluated deterministically.
Only an evaluated gate with instrument_status=valid may emit pass, fail, or inconclusive.
Only pass opens the next gate. fail, inconclusive, and not_evaluated stop the fixed sequence.
A downstream instrument failure never revises an earlier valid pass; instrument_status is scoped per gate.

boundaries.pass: Every gate-internal one-sided simultaneous confidence bound strictly clears both its frozen scientific boundary and minimum practical effect.
boundaries.fail: At least one adverse simultaneous bound strictly clears its frozen failure boundary.
boundaries.inconclusive: Every remaining valid-instrument outcome, including equality.
boundaries.not_evaluated: The gate instrument is non-valid or the gate was not reached. This is not evidence about the scientific hypothesis.

gate_state_machine.multiplicity: Use simultaneous or max-statistic intervals inside a gate, then fixed-sequence testing at familywise alpha 0.05.

extension_policy.inconclusive_extension: Only a versioned extension using fresh disjoint holdouts under a newly frozen sampling manifest is allowed. Prior and new outcomes are not pooled.
extension_policy.failed_gate_extension: A failed gate requires a new protocol or hypothesis and a fresh holdout; it cannot be reopened by adding observations.
extension_policy.prior_record: The prior result remains immutable and is reported beside any extension.

render_and_seal.formula_redundancy: Every defining statistic appears in ASCII, rendered mathematical form, and adjacent prose.
